name: IC Memory — 5V — PSOP
description: Memory ICs for 5V surface-mount applications featuring PSOP package footprints such as PSOP-44.
selection_hints: Choose when requiring 5V memory ICs in SMD PSOP packaging.
Use when matching the PSOP-44_16.9x27.17mm_P1.27mm footprint.
Suitable for designs referencing KiCad memory symbols like 28F400.
avoid_when: Do not use if the application requires operating voltages other than 5V.
Avoid when the PCB layout requires through-hole or non-PSOP packages.
Do not use if footprint requirements differ from PSOP-44_16.9x27.17mm_P1.27mm.
